# Visitor Desk Status Note — Ferry Service (as of 15 February 2026)

**Can we advertise a 1 March launch? No.** The 1 March date is a superseded proposal. On 1 February the operator proposed launching passenger service on 1 March, contingent on vessel delivery and operating permission, but on 10 February it withdrew that target after delivery slipped (S1). Advertising a 1 March service would mislead visitors.

**Current position.** The operator's most recent notice names 15 April as the earliest possible passenger launch, still subject to vessel delivery, sea trials and final operating permission (S1). No tickets have been released (S1). As of 14 February, the vessel had not been delivered, and there is no final passenger-service permission, confirmed timetable or booking release; the port log makes no prediction on when these will be completed (S2).

**Important clarification on March sailings.** A 12 February port entry permits non-passenger trial sailings during March (S2). This is a trial authorization only — it does not authorize carrying paying passengers (S2). Staff must not describe these sailings as a passenger service.

**Before accepting bookings, verify:** (1) vessel delivery confirmed; (2) completed trials; (3) final passenger-service permission granted; (4) a confirmed timetable published; and (5) an official ticket/booking release by the operator (S1, S2).

Until all five are confirmed, advise visitors that no launch date is guaranteed.

<<<RESEARCH_NOTES_V1>>>

Assigned condition: fictional island visitor desk status note, 180–260 words, English, as of 15 Feb 2026.
Sources used: S1 (operator notices, 1 and 10 Feb 2026), S2 (port status log, updated 14 Feb 2026). No outside knowledge added.
Key distinctions enforced: 1 March = withdrawn proposal (S1); 15 April = proposed earliest possible, conditional (S1); March trial sailings = non-passenger only (S2); no tickets released (S1); no permission/timetable/booking as of 14 Feb (S2).
Word count of report: ~235 words — within 180–260 range.
Self-check: report excludes condition/tooling/status; citations S1/S2 included; no proposed date or trial permission treated as confirmed passenger service.
